text: CodeAgent expresses tool calls and actions as executable Python code snippets
quote: CodeAgent generates tool calls as Python code snippets.

text: ToolCallingAgent writes tool calls as structured JSON instead of code
quote: ToolCallingAgent writes tool calls as structured JSON.

text: Developers can whitelist extra Python modules the agent's code executor is allowed to import
quote: You can authorize additional imports by passing the authorized modules as a list of strings in argument `additional_authorized_imports`

text: Custom tools are built by subclassing Tool and implementing a forward method for the tool's logic
quote: The custom tool subclasses Tool to inherit useful methods... A `forward` method which contains the inference code to be executed.

text: Custom tools can be published to the Hugging Face Hub as a Space repo via push_to_hub()
quote: You can share your custom tool to the Hub as a Space repository by calling push_to_hub() on the tool.

text: Code execution can be sandboxed via Modal, Blaxel, E2B, or Docker for security
quote: To make it secure, we support executing in sandboxed environment via Modal, Blaxel, E2B, or Docker.

text: Agent runs can be replayed step-by-step via agent.replay()
quote: You can also use `agent.replay()`, as follows

text: Step callbacks let developers dynamically modify the agent's memory during execution
quote: You can also use step callbacks to dynamically change the agent’s memory.

text: Agents can be run one step at a time, useful for tool calls that take a long time (e.g. days)
quote: This can be useful in case you have tool calls that take days: you can just run your agents step by step.

text: Agent runs can be instrumented using the OpenTelemetry standard
quote: We’ve adopted the OpenTelemetry standard for instrumenting agent runs.

text: A manager agent can be given managed_agents so it can orchestrate other agents
quote: Then we create a manager agent, and upon initialization we pass our managed agent to it in its `managed_agents` argument.

text: smolagents works with any LLM: local transformers/ollama models, Hub-hosted providers, or OpenAI/Anthropic/etc via LiteLLM integration
quote: smolagents supports any LLM. It can be a local `transformers` or `ollama` model, one of many providers on the Hub, or any model from OpenAI, Anthropic and many others via our LiteLLM integration.

text: Ships CLI utilities (smolagent, webagent) to run agents without writing boilerplate code
quote: CLI Tools: Comes with command-line utilities (smolagent, webagent) for quickly running agents without writing boilerplate code.

text: Agents can use tools from any MCP server, from LangChain, or even use a Hub Space as a tool
quote: You can use tools from any MCP server, from LangChain, you can even use a Hub Space as a tool.

text: Whole agents can be pushed to or pulled from the Hugging Face Hub for sharing/reuse
quote:
agent.push_to_hub("m-ric/my_agent")

# agent.from_hub("m-ric/my_agent") to load an agent from Hub

text: Agents support multimodal inputs: text, vision, video, and audio
quote: Agents support text, vision, video, even audio inputs!

text: A rebuilt, more secure LocalPythonExecutor is used to sandbox code execution locally
quote: we have re-built a more secure `LocalPythonExecutor` from the ground up.

text: Developers can directly access an agent's memory object to inspect or manipulate history
quote: You can access the agent’s memory using:

text: final_answer_checks lets developers supply validation functions that run before accepting a final answer
quote: final_answer_checks (list[Callable], optional) — List of validation functions to run before accepting a final answer.

text: planning_interval lets the agent periodically run a dedicated planning step during a run
quote: planning_interval (int, optional) — Interval at which the agent will run a planning step.

text: An agent can be instantiated and run with a task in just a couple lines of code
quote:
agent = CodeAgent(tools=[], model=model)

# Run the agent with a task
result = agent.run("Calculate the sum of numbers from 1 to 10")

text: Tools wrap a function together with metadata describing usage so the LLM knows how to call it
quote: the tool is a class that wraps a function with metadata that helps the LLM understand how to use it

text: Multiple agents can collaborate together as an agentic system to solve a problem (e.g. using the web)
quote: an agentic system with several agents collaborating to solve problems using the web!

text: max_steps parameter caps how many steps an agent run may take
quote: max_steps: int = 20 ... planning_interval: int | None = None

text: Installing the toolkit extra bundles default tools such as web search
quote: pip install 'smolagents[toolkit]'  # Includes default tools like web search
